answer_1.quote: We evaluate our model on multi-choice tasks and one narrative generation task.
answer_1.outputs: Contrastive narratives and counterfactual story endings

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation metrics include BLEU4, BertScore, ENTScore, and HMean= 2•BLEU4•ENTScore / (BLEU4+ENTScore).

answer_3.quote: We use off-the-shelf GPT2 to calculate Fluency.

answer_4.quote: Three annotators are recruited to make a preference among win, tie, and lose given the counterfactual context and two outputs by our model and a baseline respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared outputs pairwise and chose win, tie, or lose based on criteria including Fluency, Min-Edits, Coherence, Similarity, and SubtleDifference.
